title_en: Shrimali and Koshmali (villages in Surat district)
translation:
Shrimali, Koshmali

In Surat district, next to Orna, there is a village named Shrimali. There, in a temple, are the images of three great souls: Gyaniji, Madhavdasji, and Bhandasji — the images of all three together. Some time ago, since these images had grown old, new images were installed in their place.

Thus, among these images, our own Gyaniji Maharaj too sits enshrined in that temple. Therefore this Shrimali is a holy place (punya sthali) for us.
